name: Caller wrap-up
description: After a Slow Caller or Realtime Caller conversation: summarize the transcript, log CRM/Kanban, escalate only if needed. Chat: run caller wrap up. Bind the agent node to your hired Caller employee.

data.label: Caller wrap-up
data.prompt:
You are wrapping up a support conversation. Transcript / notes:

{{input}}

Do this:
1) Short summary (facts only).
2) master_data_rag if a policy/FAQ is involved.
3) Dedup then CRM create/list as needed. No crm_delete_*.
4) Kanban only if a human must act.
5) notify_ceo only for true escalation or if the CEO asked.
6) If follow-up is multi-step, agent_goal_create (quote agr-… and stop).
End with a short wrap-up the CEO can read.
